cases.title: Tucuruí dam and subsidised power for Albras, Alunorte and Alumar
cases.money: US$3.4 bn, 20-year power contract renewed 1 May 2004
cases.reason: "Contract renewed 1 May 2004 for 20 years (US$3.4 bn, US$170 mn a year)"; set up under Geisel/Figueiredo.

cases.title: BNDES loans to privatization buyers
cases.money: R$22 bn of BNDES money to power distributors (audit)
cases.reason: Collor-to-Cardoso loans; only "audit in Lula's first year" and the 2003 AES debt deal touch him.

cases.title: CC5 accounts and the Banestado CPI
cases.money: Evasion up to R$150 bn (CPMI report)
cases.who_got: CC5 account holders sending money abroad
cases.reason: Cardoso-era flows; "Lula (CPMI, installed 18 Jun 2003)": inquiry only, "ended unvoted".

cases.title: Electricity rationing and the tariff recomposition (RTE)
cases.money: R$7 bn BNDES financing of RTE
cases.who_paid: Consumers via RTE tariff; taxpayers via BNDES
cases.reason: Cardoso crisis cabinet created RTE; "settlement under Lula" kept the surcharge and BNDES loans running (judged from case summary; thin).

cases.title: Seguro-apagao (emergency capacity charge, CBEE)
cases.reason: "Cardoso, then Lula": charge raised to R$0.0067 per kWh in Feb 2005 and ended Dec 2005.

cases.title: PROES and the sale of state banks
cases.money: PROES total cost above R$73 bn (ANPUH, whole program)
cases.who_got: Itau, Bradesco and other state-bank buyers
cases.reason: Cardoso program; only link: "BEM (2004) and BEC (2005) were sold later" under Lula. Marginal, unsure.

cases.title: Cemig (MG): 1997 stake sale and the shareholders' agreement fight
cases.money: SEB debt to BNDES R$3.19 bn (end 2008)
cases.reason: State-level 1997 sale; 2007-09 BNDES settlement of the buyer's debt overlaps Lula 2, no federal act named. Unsure.

cases.title: Oil and gas concession rounds 5 to 13 (ANP)
cases.money: Round 7 signing bonus R$1,085 mn (Round 6: R$665 mn)
cases.who_got: Petrobras, foreign majors, small Brazilian firms
cases.who_paid: The Union gave up subsoil rights for bonuses
cases.reason: Concession model of Lei 9.478/1997 (inherited); Lula held rounds 5-10 and stopped pre-salt rounds "after the 2007 pre-salt discoveries". Frade link weak (round not identified).

cases.title: BNDES export-service loans to Brazilian contractors abroad (Odebrecht, Mariel, Angola)
cases.money: US$10.5 bn service-export disbursements 1998-2019
cases.who_got: Odebrecht (76%), Andrade Gutierrez, other contractors; Cuba/Angola borrowers
cases.who_paid: BNDES and Treasury carry default risk
cases.reason: Program dates from 1998; Lula era scaled it, e.g. Mariel port financing US$692 mn (2008-14).

cases.title: Petrobras contractor cartel and kickbacks (Lava Jato) and the leniency deals
cases.money: MPF civil suits R$44.7 bn
cases.who_got: Odebrecht, Andrade Gutierrez and cartel firms; parties PP/PT/PMDB
cases.reason: A cartel/kickback scheme "about 2004-2014", not a government-signed deal; unsure, could be read as started via Petrobras tenders.

cases.title: PPP law and the first PPP, São Paulo Metro Line 4
cases.money: Govt pays 80% of Line 4 civil works (no total)
cases.reason: "Sponsored and administrative concessions under Lei 11.079 of 30 Dec 2004" (Lula 1 federal PPP law).

cases.title: Public forest concessions (Lei de Gestão de Florestas Públicas)
cases.money: R$5.5 mn paid by concessionaires up to 2012
cases.reason: "Lei 11.284/2006, with tenders run by the forest service. Contracts allow up to 40 years."

cases.title: Madeira River dams: Santo Antonio and Jirau (Rondônia)
cases.money: BNDES loans R$6.1 bn (Santo Antonio) + R$7.2 bn (Jirau)
cases.who_got: Santo Antonio and Jirau consortia (Odebrecht, Furnas, Cemig...)
cases.who_paid: Displaced riverside residents; Union via Furnas stake and BNDES
cases.reason: "ANEEL auctions in 2007-2008 and BNDES project-finance loans" (Santo Antonio 10 Dec 2007, Jirau May 2008).

cases.title: BNDES 'national champion' equity in JBS and Bertin
cases.money: BNDES disbursements to JBS group R$8.11 bn (2007-13)
cases.reason: "Discretionary BNDESPar equity purchases and debentures under the 'national champions' industrial policy"; Bertin stake bought 2008.

cases.title: Eike Batista's EBX group (OGX, MMX, LLX/Prumo, OSX, MPX)
cases.money: R$10.4 bn BNDES granted to Eike companies (approved, not disbursed)
cases.reason: BNDES/BNDESPar credit "since 2007"; OGX collapsed 2013 under Dilma.

cases.title: Oi / Brasil Telecom merger ('supertele') and public-bank exposure
cases.money: BNDES loan R$2.569 bn to restructure Telemar control
cases.who_paid: BNDES, Banco do Brasil, Caixa and the Union
cases.reason: "Decree 6.654/2008 (new Plano Geral de Outorgas) plus BNDES credit" enabled the Oi/Brasil Telecom merger.

cases.title: Votorantim Celulose (VCP) buys Aracruz and becomes Fibria
cases.money: BNDES commitment up to R$2.4 bn
cases.reason: "BNDES equity and credit support for a private merger" (VCP buys Aracruz, 2008-09).

cases.title: Angra 3 nuclear plant contracts
cases.money: Total cost over R$25 bn incl. sunk costs (2008 est. R$8.3 bn)
cases.reason: Inherited nuclear plant relaunched in 2008 ("Lula 2, Dilma 1 and 2, Temer"); cartel tender itself was 2013 under Dilma.

cases.title: Treasury funding of BNDES and PSI subsidised credit ('bolsa-empresário')
cases.money: Treasury transfers to BNDES since 2008: R$414 bn (subsidy est. R$11.6-15.9 bn for 2008-10)
cases.reason: "Treasury bond issues on-lent to BNDES at TJLP" from 2008; the transfers are loans, not a cost; the cost is the subsidy figure.

cases.title: Terra Legal: land regularisation in the Amazon (MP 458/2009, Lei 11.952/2009)
cases.money: 28,331 titles, 2.06 mn ha issued to 2017 (no price)
cases.reason: "MP 458/2009 converted into Lei 11.952/2009."

cases.title: Caixa buys a stake in Banco Panamericano
cases.money: Caixa paid R$739 mn for 35.54%
cases.who_paid: FGC (banks) for the R$2.5 bn hole; Caixa risk
cases.reason: Caixa equity purchase, Dec 2009 (70%) and Jul 2010; Central Bank approved 15 Jul 2010.

cases.title: Belo Monte dam (Xingu, Pará)
cases.money: BNDES loan R$22.5 bn of R$28.9 bn investment
cases.who_paid: Xingu Indigenous and riverine people; Treasury via BNDES
cases.reason: "A legislative decree (DL 788/2005) authorised works without prior Indigenous consultation, followed by an ANEEL auction" (April 2010); loan Nov 2012 under Dilma.

cases.title: Cessão onerosa and the 2010 Petrobras capitalisation
cases.money: Petrobras paid about R$75 bn (US$42 bn) for 5 bn barrels
cases.who_paid: The Union and Petrobras minority shareholders
cases.reason: "Lei 12.276/2010, with payment in Treasury securities within the Petrobras capitalisation."

cases.title: Pre-salt production-sharing regime (Lei 12.351/2010) and the Libra auction (2013)
cases.money: Libra signing bonus R$15 bn (2013)
cases.who_got: Libra consortium (Petrobras, Shell, Total, CNPC, CNOOC)
cases.reason: "Lei 12.351/2010: production sharing"; the Libra auction itself was 2013 under Dilma.

cases.title: Sete Brasil (drilling-rig company for the pre-salt)
cases.money: Debt at judicial recovery about R$14-18 bn
cases.who_paid: Pension funds, FI-FGTS, Union as largest creditor
cases.reason: Rig company for pre-salt founded 2010 under "Lula 2"; collapsed 2016.

cases.title: Aracruz Celulose and Tupinikim/Guarani land (Espírito Santo)
cases.money: About 11,900 ha transferred to Tupinikim/Guarani (no money)
cases.reason: Aracruz subsidy case from the dictatorship; "a 2006 TAC transferred about 11,900 ha". Lula not named: unsure.

cases.title: Itaipu: contracts and beneficiaries
cases.money: Brazil payments to Paraguay US$120 mn to US$360 mn a year (2009 deal)
cases.reason: 1973 treaty inherited; "The 2009 deal raised Paraguay's compensation by 200%". Lula not named in text: unsure.

cases.title: FCVS (housing-fund salary-variation compensation)
cases.money: Total FCVS debt not confirmed
cases.reason: Measures cited are Lei 10.150/2000 and a 2011 rider; Lula is named but not tied to any act.

cases.title: Gleba/Fazenda Curua (Altamira), Grupo C.R. Almeida
cases.money: About 4.5 mn ha of public land
cases.reason: 1984/1993 fraud; "Lula/Dilma period (2011 sentence)": a court cancelled the registration.

cases.title: Lei Kandir: ICMS exemption on exports of primary goods
cases.money: State losses R$268.9 bn 1997-2016 (settlement R$58 bn, 2020)
cases.who_got: Exporters of ore, soy, meat, pulp
cases.reason: "EC 42/2003 wrote the exemption into the Constitution and created ADCT art. 91"; Lula named nowhere; unsure.

cases.title: Dividend tax exemption
cases.money: R$43 bn a year forgone (Ipea, 2015 estimate)
cases.reason: "After about 30 years, Lei 15.270/2025 reintroduced a withholding, effective 1 Jan 2026" (Lula III); old dividends stay exempt.

cases.title: Oil royalties and the special participation
cases.money: Royalties and special participation R$58.22 bn paid 2024
cases.reason: Concession model from 1997; Lula (2010) added "production sharing in the pre-salt (Lei 12.351/2010)". Mixed rent-sharing case, unsure.

cases.title: Repetro: customs regime for oil and gas equipment
cases.money: R$260 bn of incentives to 267 firms 2015-2023
cases.reason: Regime from 1999; "Lei 12.276/2010 and 12.351/2010 (pre-salt)" extended it in Lula 2. Lula not named: unsure.

cases.title: REFIS and tax amnesties (special instalment programs)
cases.money: Refis da Crise forgave R$60.9 bn (all ~40 programs cost R$176 bn)
cases.who_paid: The Treasury and social security funds
cases.reason: "Lula (Paes 2003, Paex 2006, Refis da Crise 2009)": each is a "medida provisoria converted into law".

cases.title: Para registry with more land than the state, and the CNJ cancellations
cases.money: 91.1 mn ha of Para registrations cancelled (land, no money)
cases.who_got: Claimants through phantom owners and fake inventories
cases.who_paid: The state and the Union (land lost)
cases.reason: Lula-era cancellations: "Provimento 13/2006 blocked registrations", CNJ-driven cancellations hit 10,728 registrations.

cases.title: Federal tax expenditures (gastos tributarios) series
cases.money: Federal tax expenditure R$519 bn in 2023 (R$114.8 bn in 2008)
cases.reason: "The series grows under all of them" (Lula II, Dilma, Temer, Bolsonaro, Lula III).

cases.title: Terra Legal: prices charged versus market value, and the TCU audits
cases.money: R$62-88 bn forgone if 19.6 mn ha privatised at legal values
cases.reason: "Lei 11.952 art. 12: larger areas at 10% to 50% of the INCRA minimum land-value table"; the figure is a counterfactual.

cases.title: Amnesty laws and moving cutoff dates
cases.money: 19.6 mn ha undesignated federal land in play (no money)
cases.who_got: Occupants up to 2,500 ha; large claimants
cases.reason: "Lei 11.952 set a cutoff of 22 July 2008"; Temer and Bolsonaro later moved it.

cases.title: Votorantim and Banco do Brasil
cases.money: R$4.2 bn for 49.99% of Banco Votorantim
cases.reason: "Banco do Brasil bought 49.99% of Banco Votorantim for R$4.2 bn, announced Jan-Sep 2009."

cases.title: Panamericano and Caixa
cases.money: FGC loan to controller R$2.5 bn; Caixa bought 36.6%
cases.reason: Companion to e5-14: "Caixa bought a stake in Banco Panamericano in Dec 2009".

cases.title: Petrobras import-parity pricing (PPI) and dividends to private shareholders
cases.money: Dividends announced 2022: R$215.7 bn (Union got about R$79 bn)
cases.reason: "New pricing formula announced May 2023"; payout rule cut from 60% to 45% in 2023.

cases.title: Early renewal of Vale railway concessions (EFVM, EFC) and Rumo Malha Paulista
cases.money: Final outorga R$11.8 bn (commitments R$24.7 bn to 2057)
cases.reason: Temer/Bolsonaro early renewal; "Repactuation: Dec 2024 protocol of about R$ 17 bn" under Lula 3. Lula not named: unsure.

cases.title: Ferrogrão and the cut of Jamanxim National Park (Lei 13.452/2017)
cases.money: 862 ha cut from Jamanxim park (no money)
cases.who_got: Grain traders via the railway concession
cases.reason: Temer law; "Lula 3 (STF ruling)" is a court validation in May 2026, not a government act.

cases.title: Garimpo expansion, Yanomami crisis and PL 191/2020 (mining on Indigenous land)
cases.money: Mining deforestation up 309% (no money)
cases.reason: Bolsonaro-era failure; Lula 3 "declared a national public-health emergency (ESPIN, 20 Jan 2023)".

cases.title: Federal airport concession rounds 2019-2022 (5th, 6th, 7th) and the returns of Viracopos and Galeão
cases.money: 5th round total R$2.377 bn vs minimum R$219 mn (2019)
cases.who_paid: Taxpayers carrying hand-backs of the 2010-14 round
cases.reason: Bolsonaro held all three auctions; Lula 3 handled "relicitacoes" (Viracopos, Galeao).

cases.title: Federal road concessions 2019-2025 (Dutra 2021, relicitação and repactuação)
cases.money: Dutra outorga R$1.77 bn; 2023-24: 9 auctions, R$111 bn potential investment
cases.reason: Lula 3 ran "2023-25 rounds, repactuacao" and the 2023 optimization program (Portaria 848) on inherited contracts.

cases.title: RLAM refinery (Bahia) sold to Mubadala / Acelen
cases.money: Sale price US$1.65 bn (Petrobras base scenario US$3.04 bn)
cases.who_paid: Bahia fuel buyers; Treasury if price too low
cases.reason: Bolsonaro sale; "Petrobras resumed talks to buy the refinery back"; no deal yet, so only partly reversed. Unsure.

cases.title: Petrobras refinery sales 2021-2023 (Reman, Lubnor, SIX; failed Refap, Repar, RNEST)
cases.money: Reman US$189.5-257.2 mn; Lubnor US$34 mn
cases.reason: "Lubnor contract terminated 27 Nov 2023"; Lula 3 (cancellation) of refinery sales.

cases.title: Petrobras field and gas asset sales and divestment totals (Polo Bahia Terra, Carmópolis, Gaspetro/Bahiagas)
cases.money: Compass paid R$2.03 bn for 51% of Gaspetro; Carmopolis US$1.1 bn
cases.who_paid: Union and Petrobras shareholders if prices low
cases.reason: Bolsonaro sales; "Lula 3 (end of E&P divestments)".

cases.title: Correios: privatization attempt and 2025 financial crisis
cases.money: Treasury-guaranteed bank loan R$12 bn (2025)
cases.reason: Privatization bill (PL 591/2021) stalled; Lula 3 backed a R$12 bn loan and R$6 bn injection to keep it public.

cases.title: Eletrobras 10% voting cap and the Union's reply (ADI 7385)
cases.money: Eletronuclear/Angra investment R$2.4 bn in settlement
cases.who_got: Private Eletrobras shareholders keep the 10% cap
cases.who_paid: Union (about 42% of common shares, limited votes)
cases.reason: Union challenged the voting cap (ADI 7385) and won board seats in a "Settlement in the STF conciliation centre".

cases.title: Desenrola Brasil and Novo Desenrola (household-debt relief)
cases.money: Lender discounts R$126 bn face value; guarantees up to R$15 bn
cases.who_got: Indebted households (and lenders recovering bad debt)
cases.who_paid: Banks (write-downs) and a small public guarantee
cases.reason: "Desenrola Brasil": household debt relief with FGO guarantee.

cases.title: Foz do Amazonas / Margem Equatorial: licensing and block auction
cases.money: Total signing bonus R$989.26 mn for 34 blocks
cases.reason: "ANP permanent-offer auction plus Ibama licensing" in Jun 2025 under Lula 3.

cases.title: Marco Temporal (Lei 14.701/2023 and STF ruling)
cases.money: No price; land rights
cases.who_got: Landholders, agribusiness, mining, energy (had it stood)
cases.reason: "Ordinary law passed by Congress after overriding vetoes" (Lei 14.701/2023); STF later struck the marco.

cases.title: Ports: STS10 terminal (Santos) and other leasings
cases.money: Outorga floor R$500 mn vs R$1.044 bn total
cases.reason: STS10 port lease auction launched under Lula 3; no award, suspension requested Apr 2026.

cases.title: General Environmental Licensing Law (Lei 15.190/2025, 'PL da devastação') and LAE
cases.money: No price; 52-56 of 63 vetoes overridden
cases.reason: "Law approved by Congress, with vetoes overridden" (Lei 15.190/2025); sanctioned with 63 vetoes.

cases.title: Federal tax expenditures (renúncias / gastos tributários)
cases.money: Federal tax expenditure R$543.7 bn in 2025 (4.4% of GDP)
cases.reason: "The trend has grown": 4.8% of GDP in 2025 versus 1.3% in 2002 (FGV, snippet).

cases.title: Redata: special tax regime for data centers
cases.money: Waivers about R$5.2 bn in 2026, then R$1 bn a year
cases.who_got: Data-center investors, largely foreign big tech
cases.reason: "Tax-regime law replacing a lapsed provisional measure" (Redata), Lula 3.

cases.title: Braskem control sale (Novonor to IG4)
cases.money: No cash price; IG4 bought about R$20 bn of Novonor debts
cases.reason: Private control sale where Petrobras stays co-controller via new shareholder agreement; government role is indirect. Unsure.
